description:
Cast Matoya by paying {2}{U}.
When Matoya enters the battlefield, Gossip's Talent's first ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Gossip's Talent's first ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.
